## Envelope interface

What one `load` returns, per key and per call. A load never throws for a key it could not read: it reports it. Every key it was given appears in exactly one of `values`<!-- -->, `absent`<!-- -->, `unknown`<!-- -->; a key in `values` may also appear in `cut`<!-- -->, more than once (1000 events and 7 days of 30).

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface Envelope<K, V> 
```
